env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stderr '^9 16$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
stderr '^9 16$'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectmakeconst

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

const K = 3

func main() {
	a := make([]int, K*K)
	n := 4
	b := make([]int, n*n)
	println(len(a), len(b))
}
